senses.definition_en: forum user, forum member, forumer

examples.english: In spite of their investment not being based on objective criteria of the company's economic situation, the board users have celebrated it as a feat that they've been able to confront Wall Street giants as equals, which many of them see as revenge after years of observing how the great funds manipulated the market as they pleased.
examples.ref: 2021 January 27, Álvaro Sánchez, “Una legión de foreros de Reddit hace perder miles de millones a fondos bajistas de Wall Street”, in El País:
examples.text: Pese a que su inversión no se basa en criterios objetivos sobre la situación económica de la compañía, los foreros han celebrado como una hazaña su capacidad de enfrentarse de tú a tú a gigantes de Wall Street, en lo que muchos de ellos ven como una venganza tras años de ver cómo eran los grandes fondos los que manipulaban el mercado a su antojo.
examples.translation: In spite of their investment not being based on objective criteria of the company's economic situation, the board users have celebrated it as a feat that they've been able to confront Wall Street giants as equals, which many of them see as revenge after years of observing how the great funds manipulated the market as they pleased.

senses.definition_en: halfway; at the midpoint

examples.english: They arrived as usual to the neighborhood entrance where Mario García Solís lived and the three vehicles entered by different streets, a bit before arrived to the house they lived, everyone donned the balaclavas, they arrived by the two corners of the street, the house was halfway through the square.
examples.text: […] llegaron sin novedad a la entrada de la colonia donde vivía Mario Garcia^([sic – meaning García]) Solís y los tres vehiculos entraron por diferentes calles, un poco antes de llegar a la casa a donde iban, todos se pusieron los pasamontañas, llegaron por las dos esquinas de la calle, la casa estaba a mediación de la cuadra.
examples.translation: They arrived as usual to the neighborhood entrance where Mario García Solís lived and the three vehicles entered by different streets, a bit before arrived to the house they lived, everyone donned the balaclavas, they arrived by the two corners of the street, the house was halfway through the square.

examples.english: —It is halfway through the del Mar Avenue, really close to los monos bichis —tells me Gaspar Pruneda.
examples.ref: 2019, Julián Herbert, Ahora imagino cosas, Random House:
examples.text: —Está a mediación de la Avenida del Mar, muy cerca de los monos bichis —me explica Gaspar Pruneda.
examples.translation: —It is halfway through the del Mar Avenue, really close to los monos bichis —tells me Gaspar Pruneda.
